You are picking up in the middle of the work: read the repo first, do not start over. # 0. REPO STATE - Repo root: C:\Users\admin\Documents\Vigilens (Windows, PowerShell). The app lives in `frontend/` (React + Vite, JavaScript, plain CSS). Branch: `feat/frontend-dashboard`. - Phase B (Day/Night theme foundation: tokens, theme toggle, no-flash script, top bar, banners, buttons, badges, focus styles) is committed as b6b603f. A partial Phase C is committed as e69ffd8 (ZonePatterns.jsx plus edits to AuditImage, UploadZoneEditor, FindingsList, HazardLog, SeverityBadge, Icons, App.jsx and styles.css). A tag/backup of the good state may exist as `phase-c-wip`. - Baseline: `npm run build` passes (3 pre-existing Vite warnings about sample JSON being both statically and dynamically imported; do not add new warnings). `npm test` = 19 files, 50 tests, all passing. - FIRST: run `git status`, `git show --stat HEAD`, then read src/styles.css, src/App.jsx, every file in src/components/, src/lib/severity.js and src/lib/theme.js. Summarise which Phase C items below are already done and which remain. Do NOT redo finished work. - The repo root also contains files that are NOT yours: a backend teammate's code and notes (app (1).py, README-local-backend.md, vigilens-local-backend-review-* zip and folder, TEST-RESULTS-*.txt, sample-audit-v0.2.json, section8-answers-draft.md), personal notes (memory.md, op.trial.pdf) and scratch files (frontend/.tmp-*, frontend/.tmp-shots/). NEVER read them into context unnecessarily, edit, delete, move, or commit them. NEVER run `git add .`, `git add -A` or `git commit -a`. Stage files by explicit name only. Leave `frontend/public/` alone unless I say so. Leave the modified root README.md alone. # 1. HARD CONSTRAINTS (never violate; if one blocks you, stop and ask) 1. Appearance ONLY. Do not change application logic, state, data shapes, the API client, validation, fixtures or behaviour. Do not edit src/api/*, src/lib/{geometry,canAnalyse,evidence,storage,validation,exif,requestBuilder}.js, src/fixtures/*, package.json, vite.config.js or existing tests. (Severity colour literals already moved to CSS-variable strings in src/lib/severity.js; keep function names, exports and the {color,fill,stroke} shape.) 2. Stack: React + Vite, JavaScript, plain CSS. NO new dependencies, no Tailwind, no UI kit, no icon packages, no web fonts, no CDN. System font stack; inline SVG icons only (1.5px stroke, 16/20px, currentColor). 3. OVERLAY ALIGNMENT IS SACRED. The image wrapper stays `position:relative; display:inline-block; line-height:0`; the stays `display:block; max-width:100%; height:auto`; the SVG overlay stays `position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%`, viewBox "0 0 1 1", preserveAspectRatio="none". NO padding, border, margin, transform, zoom, object-fit, clipping or border-radius that crops on the wrapper or the image. Put rounded corners, borders, shadows and padding on an OUTER `.stage-frame` around the wrapper. Click-to-coordinate maths reads the IMAGE's getBoundingClientRect() and must stay exact at every window size. This appears in TWO places: AuditImage (evidence) and UploadZoneEditor (drawing). Verify both after styling. 4. LAYOUT DECISIONS (final): the full UploadZoneEditor stays in the LEFT column under the image stage (do not move or split it). The Findings | Hazard Log TABLIST stays in the inspector with its existing ARIA and the activeTab state (do not remove tabs, do not move the Hazard Log below the workspace). Restyle the Hazard Log as a proper scrollable data table inside the inspector. For print, both tabpanels must be visible. 5. Severity semantics never change: Critical = red, Medium = amber, Low = blue-grey (NEVER green), unknown/other strings = neutral grey with the raw text, Uncertainty = violet with the exact visible label "Uncertain - needs human check". Green is ONLY for "No listed violations" (finding list empty AND helmet and vest both present). Colour is never the only signal: keep text labels plus a distinct shape icon per severity. 6. Required strings stay exactly: "SAMPLE DATA - not a real audit" (and the fixture/stub/backend-mode banners, which must stay unmissable in both themes), "Preview only, not evidence", "Masked evidence unavailable", "No listed violations", "No people detected; not a safety clearance.", "No zones were checked; this is not proof the area is safe.", "Loaded at" (browser-clock time) vs "Fixture loaded at" (audit.fixture_loaded_at), "Illustrative (fixture), not a real re-check", and the report footer "Prototype audit for human review - not a compliance certification." The word "compliant" must appear nowhere in src/. 7. Accessibility is a requirement: WCAG AA contrast in BOTH themes (>= 4.5:1 text, >= 3:1 UI boundaries and focus rings), visible :focus-visible on every interactive element and on SVG overlay polygons (stroke change, not only the browser outline), Enter AND Space activate overlays, existing aria attributes untouched, >= 40x40px targets (44px for coarse pointers), prefers-reduced-motion respected. 8. Print/PDF: always renders in the Light theme with print-color-adjust: exact regardless of the chosen theme; app chrome hidden; both tabpanels visible: `@media print { [role="tabpanel"], [role="tabpanel"][hidden] { display:block !important; } }`. 9. No emoji in the UI, no console.log, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no lorem ipsum, no TODOs, no new files beyond what is needed. # 2. DESIGN DIRECTION (Apple Human Interface principles) Clarity (the image and findings are the heroes, chrome recedes, one primary action: Analyse), deference (restrained palette; colour carries meaning, not decoration), depth (subtle layered elevation in Light; in Dark, lighter surfaces plus 1px hairlines, no glows), consistency (one type scale 12/16, 13/18, 15/22, 17/24, 22/28, 28/34; weights 400/500/600; spacing tokens --space-1..8; radii 6/10/14; tabular numerals for counts, times, coordinates). Motion: 120-200ms ease-out on hover/focus/selection only. AVOID: purple/pink gradients, gradient text, glows, glassmorphism beyond the single top bar, emoji, centred-everything, identical big-shadow card grids, oversized hero sections, inconsistent icons, low-contrast grey text, bouncy hover effects. All colours live ONLY in the token definitions in styles.css (Light on :root, Dark on :root[data-theme="dark"] and via @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) guarded with :root:not([data-theme="light"]), scoped to screen so print uses Light). Components and CSS rules use var(--...) only. # 3. PHASE C TASKS (finish only what is not already done; verify each in code) 0. BUG FIRST: with sample-1 selected, the "Preview only, not evidence" frame was an empty thin strip: the sample image and its zone overlay were not visible (seen in Dark mode, after Phase B). Find the root cause (does the render? its computed height? the frame's overflow/height/min-height rules? console or network errors? is the sample image path or `public/` involved?), fix it WITHOUT changing the wrapper/img/svg geometry rules, and tell me the cause and whether Phase B introduced it. Verify sample-1, sample-2, sample-3 and an uploaded image all show correctly in both Light and Dark with their zones drawn. 1. OVERLAYS (AuditImage and UploadZoneEditor): zero hard-coded hex/rgba left in any JSX, SVG attribute or src/lib file (grep to prove it). Fills and strokes come from classes reading tokens. Hatch patterns live in one shared ZonePatterns component with ids namespaced per surface (e.g. "evidence-hazard-pattern", "editor-hazard-pattern") so references never collide. No `color + '20'` hex-alpha concatenation. Use `vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke` with px stroke widths so strokes are uniform on non-square images. Dual-stroke halo: non-interactive halo polygons behind each shape with aria-hidden="true", pointer-events:none, never focusable. Selected = thicker stroke + stronger fill. :focus-visible = stroke change to the focus-ring token plus a visible ring. All-uncertainty persons use the violet family; green only when fully equipped with no findings; unknown severities neutral grey with raw text. 2. STAGE FRAME: border, radius, hairline, shadow and padding on an OUTER .stage-frame only. The "Preview only, not evidence" tag lives on the outer frame, pointer-events:none, never over the image box. 3. ZONE EDITOR: zone rows = colour swatch + inline-editable name + hazard switch (still a real checkbox) + icon-only delete with aria-label "Delete zone {name}". Drawing toolbar as a tidy segmented group; "Finish zone" is tonal, NOT filled (Analyse stays the only filled primary button). Arrow glyphs become chevron icons with aria-labels kept. Sample picker, upload area, inputs, selects, file button tokenised with proper hit areas. 4. FINDINGS: cards with 1px border, 10px radius, 12-16px padding, no card-in-card, rule ids in the mono stack (ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace), backend message verbatim at body size. Selected = accent border + --row-selected tint. PPE chips: present / absent / "Unclear - needs human check", each with a distinct shape icon and text. "How was this checked?" and "Illustrative (fixture), not a real re-check" as a quiet disclosure with a rotating chevron. The review control stays a real fieldset with a visually hidden legend and 3 radios (Unreviewed / Reviewed / Needs human review), styled as a segmented control with a clear checked state. 5. HAZARD LOG: replace inline styles and any CSS attribute-selector hack with real classes (.table-scroll, .data-table, .is-selected). Sticky header, hairline separators (no zebra), hover and selected-row states, tabular numerals, severity cell = shape icon + text, horizontal scroll wrapper at narrow widths. Sorting/filtering behaviour unchanged. 6. STATES: designed empty stage (inline camera-frame SVG plus one sentence), loading (spinner, rotation <= 1s, static under reduced motion, plus Cancel), error panel (danger tint, secondary "Try again", no auto-retry), "No findings"/"No listed violations", the two empty-array messages above. Move remaining inline styles in App.jsx and FindingsList.jsx to classes. 7. RESPONSIVE: >=1280px two-region (stage left, ~380px inspector right); at 1024 and 768 the inspector goes below the stage; at 390 no horizontal page scroll and the theme toggle shows icons only with accessible labels. 8. PRINT: re-verify Light tokens, hidden chrome, both tabpanels visible, evidence with overlays, and the required footer, including when the app is in Dark mode. # 4. PROCESS Work in small steps; after each logical chunk run `npm run build` and `npm test` and fix every error and warning (no new warnings). Commit with clear messages by staging explicit file names only. Do not claim something works unless you ran it. When done, STOP and report; do not start any further phase. # 5. REPORT FORMAT (when you stop) (a) which items were already done vs done by you; (b) the root cause of the empty-preview bug; (c) evidence: a grep showing no raw hex/rgba in src/components and src/lib; computed styles of .zone-canvas-wrapper, its and .zone-svg unchanged; overlay alignment and click maths checked at 390, 768 and 1280 widths, with a very wide and a very tall image; a click just outside the image adds no point; keyboard-only: select a finding with Tab/Enter/Space and select an overlay with Enter AND Space; (d) build and test results; (e) exact steps for me to view Light and Dark; (f) everything you could NOT verify (e.g. other browsers, screen readers, real touch devices, a physical printer). If anything is ambiguous or a rule conflicts with a task, stop and ask ONE precise question instead of guessing. Begin by reading the repo as described in section 0.
